outstanding: Enumerate all class and planet missions, side quests, flashpoints, operations, codex entries, datacrons, seasonal and retired stories, cinematics, dialogue, companions and branch choices.
Reconcile builds and patch-specific changes, localized variants, unavailable or removed content, metadata and source provenance.
Document permission for acquisition, processing, redistribution and hosted embedding of primary game content; distinguish independently licensed commentary from copyrighted in-game material.
Recheck official patch notes and release status as this live game changes; do not infer that the listed expansions or updates are complete.
